snippet.title: UMIGAME - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
We are 2 brothers-studio developing this game, and the demo is coming june 2nd, 2025 on Steam.

-------------------------------------------------
Umigame is an online roguelite (solo or duo) where you must protect the Omnicore, an ancient magical relic that turns the environment into a weapon. Activate turrets and unleash powerful abilities to survive relentless enemy waves. Blending fast-paced action with strategic defense, Umigame offers a unique multiplayer twist on the roguelite formula.
-------------------------------------------------

Music by Miguel Lopez
https://www.instagram.com/loyer.music/
